race.comment: A multitude of chances in a very tough maiden to start the day. LAUGHING MOONS (9) for Joe Pride and the in-form Tommy Berry gets the nod. Good on debut here then looked in need of more ground last start when beaten just under three lengths over 1000m, again at this venue. Blinkers on and an extra 100m can make all the difference. WATER CITY (6) settled back in the field on debut last start then picked up nicely to be beaten just 1.6 lengths by Revolina who won at Group 3 level on Saturday. Had the measure of LAUGHING MOONS that day so she is sure to be highly competitive. TIME TO DANCE (1) returns from a five-month spell. Likely to need more ground in time on what we saw last prep but while fresh he cannot be ruled out. DUBIOUS EXPRESS (2) is back from an 18-week for a second campaign. Impressed on debut at Newcastle and another bright start is on the cards.
